performance.verdict: Paid channels fully dark; only organic GBP ever moved the needle.

findings.text: Zero spend, zero leads, zero clicks across Meta and Google Ads for the entire 28-day window — paid channels are completely inactive.
GBP actions dropped -100% in the last 7 days vs prior 7; prior period generated 33 actions including 16 direction requests and 1 call.
GA4 sessions rose +63% in the last 7 days (recent 3-day avg ~3 vs prior 3-day avg ~10 on Sep 5-7 vs Aug 25-27) — spike likely tied to the Sep-01 outlier of 28 sessions, not a sustained trend.
GHL pipeline is null and GA4 shows 0 conversions over 28 days despite 205 sessions — no intake funnel is active or connected.

suggestions.text: Confirm campaign pause status and reconnect GHL intake funnel before any spend is reactivated — 0 conversions on 205 sessions confirms a broken funnel.
suggestions.monday_update: Paid campaigns (Meta and Google Ads) have recorded $0 spend and 0 leads for the full 28-day window. GA4 shows 205 sessions with 0 conversions and GHL pipeline is null, meaning any reactivated spend would flow into a broken intake funnel. Confirm whether campaigns are intentionally paused and restore GHL pipeline tracking and form/CRM connections before restarting. Success check: at least 1 tracked conversion appearing in both GA4 and GHL within 48 hours of funnel restoration, by 2026-09-10.

suggestions.text: Watch GBP: dropped -100% last 7 days after averaging 33 actions in prior period — investigate listing status by Sep 11.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP generated 33 actions (16 directions, 16 web clicks, 1 call) in the prior 7-day window, then dropped to 0 in the most recent 7 days — a -100% change. Check that the Google Business Profile listing is active, not suspended, and that no edits triggered a re-verification hold. Success check: GBP actions return to at least 5 in a 7-day window; re-check on 2026-09-11.
